summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model repositories that host and distribute weights and developer-facing inference APIs that serve those models without infrastructure management. Hugging Face remains the dominant hub, surpassing 3 million public models as of August 2026, though download distribution is highly concentrated—roughly the top 200 models account for nearly half of all downloads. Complementing these repositories, serverless inference providers like Together AI, Fireworks AI, Replicate, SiliconFlow, and local runtimes like Ollama make open models easy to deploy and run at scale.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central repository and community hub for hosting, sharing, versioning, and discovering open AI models, datasets, and demo apps (Spaces), with an accompanying serverless Inference API and Inference Endpoints.
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public hosting and limited inference; Pro at ~$9/mo; Inference Endpoints and dedicated GPU compute billed per hour; Enterprise/Team plans available
features: Largest model and dataset repository with Git-based versioning
Transformers, Diffusers, and Datasets libraries
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Spaces for hosting demos and apps
Download and usage statistics via query-file counting
Strong open-source community and documentation
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and developers who want the broadest selection of open models, datasets, and collaborative tooling

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A local-first runtime that lets developers download and run open LLMs on their own machines (macOS, Windows, Linux) with a simple CLI and local API server.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated models in its library (e.g. Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, Phi) plus community/custom GGUF imports
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; no usage fees since models run locally on your own hardware
features: One-command model pulls and runs
Local REST API compatible with OpenAI-style clients
Quantized GGUF models for consumer hardware
Modelfile system for customizing and packaging models
Cross-platform desktop support with GPU acceleration
Offline and privacy-friendly inference
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run open models locally for prototyping, offline use, or self-hosted apps

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform for running open-source and community models via API, with support for custom model deployment using the Cog packaging framework.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community-published models spanning text, image, video, and audio
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU pricing); no subscription required
features: Run models via simple HTTP API with no infrastructure setup
Cog framework for packaging and deploying custom models
Automatic scaling to zero when idle
Broad multimodal coverage (image/video generation, upscaling, LLMs)
Webhooks and streaming support
Pay only for compute consumed
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups wanting to ship AI features quickly, especially image/video/multimodal, without managing GPUs

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A developer-facing inference and fine-tuning cloud optimized for fast, low-cost serving of open-source LLMs and multimodal models at scale.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, Mixtral, FLUX, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for inference (per million tokens, tiered by model size); dedicated endpoints and fine-tuning billed separately
features: OpenAI-compatible serverless inference API
High-throughput, low-latency optimized inference stack
Fine-tuning and dedicated GPU clusters (GPU Clusters / Instant Clusters)
Support for the latest open models including DeepSeek and Llama families
Batch inference and JSON/structured output modes
Competitive per-token pricing
platforms.best_for: Developers and companies building production apps on open LLMs who need scalable, cost-effective inference and fine-tuning

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference platform focused on fast, production-grade serving of open-weight LLMs, vision, and audio models with its optimized FireAttention engine.
platforms.model_count: 100+ curated open models plus support for custom fine-tuned deployments
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing; on-demand dedicated GPU deployments billed per GPU-hour; fine-tuning available
features: FireAttention-optimized low-latency inference
OpenAI-compatible API
Serverless and dedicated deployment options
Fine-tuning (including LoRA) and custom model hosting
Function calling, structured output, and multimodal support
Enterprise-grade reliability and compliance options
platforms.best_for: Teams needing fast, reliable, production-scale inference for open models with strong performance SLAs

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: A developer inference platform (strong presence in China and globally) offering serverless APIs for a wide range of open-source LLMs, image, audio, and video models.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models including DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Llama, FLUX, and more
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token / pay-per-use pricing with free credits for new users; competitive low-cost rates
features: OpenAI-compatible inference API
Broad coverage of leading Chinese and global open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM)
Text, image, audio, and video generation endpoints
Fast and cost-efficient serving
Fine-tuning and batch inference support
Strong availability for the Asia-Pacific developer market
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting affordable access to top Chinese and global open models, especially DeepSeek and Qwen families

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An inference platform built on custom LPU hardware delivering extremely fast token generation for open LLMs via an OpenAI-compatible API.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of supported open models (Llama, Mixtral, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek distillations)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing; free developer tier with rate limits
features: Industry-leading inference speed via LPU hardware
OpenAI-compatible API
Very low latency for real-time applications
Curated set of popular open models
GroqCloud developer console and generous free tier
Batch and streaming support
platforms.best_for: Developers building latency-sensitive, real-time applications that need the fastest possible open-model inference

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API aggregator and router that gives developers access to many open and proprietary models through a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models from dozens of providers (open and closed), routed automatically for price/availability
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token passthrough pricing with a small routing margin; credit-based billing, some free models
features: Single API for many model providers
Automatic fallback and least-cost routing
OpenAI-compatible interface
Access to both open-weight and proprietary models
Transparent per-model pricing and usage analytics
No vendor lock-in across providers
platforms.best_for: Developers who want one integration to experiment with and switch between many open and closed models
